rate_limit.label: Rate limit
rate_limit.description: Counts order attempts within a time window and rejects bursts beyond the cap. Rejected attempts still count, so retries cannot bypass it.

order_size_limit.label: Order size limit
order_size_limit.description: Caps the size of a single order by quantity and notional value to prevent fat-finger errors.

spot_funds_pnl_bounds_kill_switch.label: Realized Profit and Loss Kill Switch
spot_funds_pnl_bounds_kill_switch.description: Uses engine-computed realized profit and loss (P&L) in the account currency, net of optional passed commission. If a required input is missing, for example an FX quote needed to value realized P&L in the account currency, the engine blocks accounts under P&L control because it cannot guarantee the limit. FX is required only when needed: not for assets already in the account currency and not for accounts outside P&L control.

spot_funds_unrealized_pnl_bounds_kill_sw.label: Unrealized Profit and Loss Kill Switch
spot_funds_unrealized_pnl_bounds_kill_sw.description: Uses engine-computed unrealized profit and loss (P&L) of the account's positions in the account currency, valued at the current market price. Once the P&L leaves its bounds, the next order is rejected and the account is blocked.

spot_funds_total_pnl_bounds_kill_switch.label: Total Profit and Loss Kill Switch
spot_funds_total_pnl_bounds_kill_switch.description: Uses engine-computed total profit and loss (P&L) in the account currency: realized P&L plus the unrealized P&L of the account's positions at the current market price. Once the P&L leaves its bounds, the next order is rejected and the account is blocked.

spot_funds_limit_mode.label: Funds limit mode
spot_funds_limit_mode.description: Decides for every account whether Officer checks funds before an order. With no row stored, the mode is Check funds.
